assessments.reasoning: Five contiguous parts cover the 67,879-byte SPDX json/details/CC-BY-ND-3.0.json. The name is Creative Commons Attribution No Derivatives 3.0 Unported, the licenseId is CC-BY-ND-3.0, and isDeprecatedLicenseId is false. Both source fields give the captured URL. The string "false" in crossRef.match is consistent with limiting the result to citation.

The official repository's annotated tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b names v3.29.0. Its object.type is commit and object.sha is 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, exactly the ND detail revision. GitHub reports the tag is unsigned.

The context binding resolves the exact SPDX citation to the CC capture with SHA-256 f38359a4f5241e61cf1a98c0974cdc0062ddbfd6fd5892f7af961ce5228ad2f5. Its legal-code-body supplies the NoDerivs title, the 3.0 edition and Unported scope. The separate deed link is outside that body.

challenge.method: Checked the three ND labels against their exact locations, editions and URLs. Compared §3 of the SPDX licenseText with the inline publisher §3 to test a stronger claim of identical wording.
challenge.results: The SPDX name uses No Derivatives, its licenseText heading uses NoDerivs, and CC uses NoDerivatives in the link to 4.0 International. SPDX §3 includes “but otherwise you have no rights to make Adaptations” and cites §8(f). The captured CC paragraph proceeds from technical modifications to §8(e). Those differences defeat a verbatim match while leaving the exact citation and identifier intact.

limitations: NoDerivs, No Derivatives and the 4.0 label NoDerivatives are documentary labels in their respective contexts. Semantic equivalence, translation, adaptation, downstream grants and redistribution rights remain unassessed.

The result is specific to the generated detail and the measured CC /legalcode response. The declared canonical /legalcode.en bytes and other project files were outside the comparison. SPDX identifier status and the release tag are independent of Index active status, publisher currency and legal effect.
reasoning: The tagged SPDX record lists CC-BY-ND-3.0 and cites https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nd/3.0/legalcode in both crossRef and seeAlso. The CC page identifies the cited legal code as Attribution-NoDerivs 3.0 Unported. The correspondence rests on those fields and the release target, independently of how the two publishers spell the display name.
